1.name: Dry
1.brief: Deadpan and understated. The joke is how calmly it's said. PG.

2.name: Spicy
2.brief: Sarcastic and pointed. The scammer gets mocked openly.

3.name: Roast
3.brief: A full roast of the scammer's craftsmanship. Still no victim-blaming, slurs or jokes about nationality.

voices.name: The Critic
voices.brief: A snobby product critic reviewing a cheap knockoff.
voices.tells_shape: 2-4 tells, each a criticism of the craftsmanship plus the lesson.
voices.sample: From across the room it passes. Up close, the stitching gives it away.

voices.name: Nature Documentary
voices.brief: A hushed narrator watching a predator in its natural habitat.
voices.tells_shape: Each tell is an observed behaviour of the creature, which is the trick it uses.
voices.sample: Here, in the long grass of a free hosting plan, the phish waits. It has borrowed the colours of something trustworthy.

voices.name: Product Recall Notice
voices.brief: A deadpan corporate safety notice about a dangerous product.
voices.tells_shape: Exactly three tells, starting AFFECTED PRODUCT:, HAZARD: and REMEDY:.
voices.sample: Effective immediately, this product is recalled due to a risk of sudden account loss.

voices.name: One-Star Customer Review
voices.brief: A furious customer who ordered the real thing and got the knockoff. Funny-angry at the seller, never at themselves.
voices.tells_shape: Each tell is a complaint, and each complaint is a red flag.
voices.sample: Ordered one (1) bank login. Received a lottery-number domain. Would not phish again.

voices.name: Late-Night Infomercial
voices.brief: A pitchman selling the scam, accidentally listing every flaw as a feature.
voices.tells_shape: Each tell is a 'feature' that is actually the giveaway. One tell may open with 'But wait, there's more'.
voices.sample: Tired of real domains? Try ours: nine random digits, no extra charge!

voices.name: Play-by-Play
voices.brief: A sports commentator calling the scam live, like a game.
voices.tells_shape: Each tell is a play, the move the scammer just tried.
voices.sample: And he's stuffed the brand name into the subdomain. Oh, the audacity!

voices.name: Tasting Notes
voices.brief: A wine sommelier describing the page's nose, palate and finish.
voices.tells_shape: Exactly three tells, starting NOSE:, PALATE: and FINISH:.
voices.sample: Notes of urgency on the nose, a palate of borrowed logos, and a long finish of credential theft.

voices.name: Health Inspector
voices.brief: A restaurant inspection report: violations found, letter grade posted.
voices.tells_shape: Each tell is VIOLATION #n: followed by the problem. The verdict may be a letter grade.
voices.sample: Inspector observed a login form stored at an unsafe domain.

voices.name: True Crime Podcast
voices.brief: A breathless podcast host retelling the case, with dramatic pauses.
voices.tells_shape: The tells are clues in the order a detective would find them.
voices.sample: It looked like any other login page. But the address bar was hiding something.

voices.name: Dating Profile Red Flags
voices.brief: A friend reading the phish's dating profile out loud and spotting the red flags.
voices.tells_shape: Each tell is a red flag, and it ends with a swipe verdict.
voices.sample: Says he's a bank. Lives on a .top domain. Wants your password on the first date.

voices.name: Museum Placard
voices.brief: A pompous curator describing an artifact in a glass case.
voices.tells_shape: Each tell is a feature the curator points out, like Note the... or Observe the...
voices.sample: Credential Lure, mixed media (stolen CSS, free hosting), circa this Tuesday.

voices.name: Horoscope
voices.brief: An astrologer reading the domain's chart, where every prediction is a warning.
voices.tells_shape: Each tell is a reading or a prediction.
voices.sample: With .top rising in your house of hosting, a stranger will ask for your recovery phrase. Do not give it to them.
